name: Frostmaw
summary: In the Alterac Mountains, a rare yeti hunt calls you far from home. Melor Stonehoof sends you after Frostmaw and awaits his mane in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: A Distant Hunt
sections.body: Melor Stonehoof sends you far from home to hunt Frostmaw in the Alterac Mountains. The yeti’s white coat blends with the mountain snow, and he rarely shows himself. Melor gives you a scroll explaining how to lure him. Bring Frostmaw’s mane back to Melor in Thunder Bluff, and your journey will be complete.

faq.answer: Frostmaw is a yeti in the Alterac Mountains. His white coat blends with the snow, and he rarely appears.
You can find Frostmaw in the Alterac Mountains, where his white coat blends with the snow.
Melor Stonehoof gives you a scroll with instructions for luring Frostmaw.

faq.q: What does Melor want from Frostmaw?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof asks you to bring Frostmaw’s mane to him in Thunder Bluff.
